name: feishu-traework-local-auth
description: Optional local helper to reuse this machine's user-owned TraeWork Feishu authorization with official lark-cli environment credentials.

interface.shortDescription: Reuse your own TraeWork Feishu auth on this machine with lark-cli.
interface.longDescription: Optional advanced plugin for a person who already completed Feishu authorization for TraeWork on this computer. It reads only that OS user's Trae session, fetches the short-lived Feishu user token already granted to TraeWork, and runs official lark-cli through LARKSUITE_CLI_* environment credentials. Each recipient must authorize on their own machine. Not the default Feishu Next auth path. Windows paths are implemented but not live-tested.
defaultPrompt: Use $feishu-traework-local-auth:feishu-traework-local-auth to reuse this machine's TraeWork Feishu auth.
Use $feishu-traework-local-auth:feishu-traework-local-auth to introduce itself and Windows support.
Use $feishu-traework-local-auth:feishu-traework-local-auth to run lark-cli with that local auth.
